roadmapItems.title: FortiSASE Integration
roadmapItems.description: Integrate FortiSASE platform for unified SASE delivery including ZTNA, SWG and CASB capabilities.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Enables customers to consolidate network security stack into a single managed SASE service.
roadmapItems.notes: Phase 1 focuses on ZTNA and SWG. CASB follow-on in Q3.

roadmapItems.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
roadmapItems.description: Build a self-service portal allowing customers to manage SASE policies, view dashboards and raise support tickets.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Reduces operational dependency on service desk. Improves customer autonomy.

roadmapItems.title: Multitenant Reporting
roadmapItems.description: Deliver per-tenant security and usage reporting across the SASE platform for MSP customers.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Gives MSP partners tenant-level visibility across their customer base.

roadmapItems.title: SD-WAN Orchestration Upgrade
roadmapItems.description: Upgrade orchestration layer to support multi-vendor SD-WAN fabrics and policy-based routing.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Simplifies SD-WAN management for multi-vendor environments.

roadmapItems.title: Azure Landing Zone Uplift
roadmapItems.description: Rebuild Azure landing zones to align with CAF best practices including governance, networking and identity baseline.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Provides enterprise-grade cloud foundations with consistent governance. Reduces misconfiguration risk.
roadmapItems.notes: Working with customer architects on networking topology.

roadmapItems.title: Cost Optimisation Dashboard
roadmapItems.description: Build a real-time cost optimisation dashboard showing rightsizing recommendations, reserved instance coverage and waste analysis.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Helps customers reduce cloud spend by 15-25% through actionable recommendations.
roadmapItems.notes: Will leverage Azure Advisor and custom cost APIs.

roadmapItems.title: Backup Immutability Enhancement
roadmapItems.description: Implement immutable backup vaults with WORM compliance to protect against ransomware and accidental deletion.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Critical for ransomware protection. Required for compliance-driven customers.
roadmapItems.notes: Evaluating Veeam and Commvault immutability features.

roadmapItems.title: SaaS Backup for M365
roadmapItems.description: Add Microsoft 365 backup coverage including Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Fills a major gap. Most customers assume M365 data is backed up by Microsoft.

roadmapItems.title: SD-WAN Analytics Engine
roadmapItems.description: Advanced analytics engine for SD-WAN traffic patterns, anomaly detection and performance SLA tracking.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Proactive detection of network issues and SLA breaches.
roadmapItems.notes: Blocked waiting on orchestration upgrade completion.

roadmapItems.title: Cloud Monitoring Stack
roadmapItems.description: Deploy unified monitoring and alerting stack across Azure and AWS environments.
roadmapItems.customerImpact: Single pane of glass for cloud infrastructure health.
